title: Then and now
goal: Tell how a place or a life has changed, mixing used to, was going to, should have and could have.

intro.text: Talk about how things have changed: what used to be (`-(I)rdI`), what was going to happen (`-(y)AcAktI`), and what should or could have been (`-mAlIydI`, `-(y)AbilIrdI`). *Hiçbir şey eskisi gibi değil*: nothing is as it used to be.

vocab.en: as before, as it used to be
instead of; in place of (after the genitive)

exercises.title: Eski mahallem
exercises.passage:
Çocukken İzmir'de, küçük bir mahallede otururduk. Sokağımız sessizdi ve her evin bir bahçesi vardı. Okuldan sonra hep sokakta oynardık. Köşede yaşlı bir bakkal vardı; bize hep şeker verirdi.

Geçen yaz mahalleye tekrar gittim. Her şey çok değişmişti. Bahçeli evlerin yerinde yüksek apartmanlar vardı ve sokak çok gürültülüydü. Bakkalın yerine büyük bir market açmışlardı. Eski komşumuz Fatma Hanım'a uğrayacaktım, ama o da taşınmıştı. Daha önce gelmeliydim.

glossary.en: in its place, where … used to be

exercises.translation: As a child I lived in a small neighbourhood in Izmir. Our street was quiet and every house had a garden. After school we always played in the street. There was an old grocer on the corner; he always used to give us sweets. Last summer I went back to the neighbourhood. Everything had changed a lot. Where the houses with gardens had been, there were tall apartment buildings, and the street was very noisy. They had opened a big supermarket in place of the grocer's. I was going to drop in on our old neighbour, Fatma Hanım, but she had moved too. I should have come sooner.

questions.q: Where did the narrator grow up?
options: In a small neighbourhood in Izmir
In a big apartment building in Istanbul

questions.q: What did the old grocer use to do?
questions.explain: *Bize hep şeker verirdi*: the past aorist, a habit, **he always used to give us sweets**.

questions.q: Did the narrator see Fatma Hanım?
questions.explain: *Uğrayacaktım*: a plan that fell through. *Taşınmıştı*: she had moved before the visit.

questions.q: What does *Daha önce gelmeliydim* tell you?
options: The narrator regrets not coming sooner
The narrator will come back soon

exercises.text: Eskiden bu sokak çok sessizdi. Artık hiçbir şey eskisi ___ değil.
exercises.en: This street used to be very quiet. Nothing is as it used to be any more.

reject.why: *Eskisi kadar* needs an adjective: *eskisi kadar sessiz* (as quiet as before). **As it used to be** is *eskisi gibi*.

exercises.explain: *Eskisi gibi*: **like before, as it used to be**.

exercises.prompt: We used to go to the same primary school.

reject.why: *Gittik* is a plain past, **we went**. **Used to go** is *giderdik*.

exercises.question: What does Can admit?

context.tr: Dün akşam neden gelmedin? Seni bekledik.
context.en: Why didn't you come last night? We waited for you.

context.tr: Gelecektim, ama son anda annem aradı.
context.en: I was going to come, but my mother called at the last minute.
You could have let us know!
You're right. I should have called you. I'm sorry.

exercises.explain: *Aramalıydım*: **I should have called**. *Gelecektim* shows he had meant to come.

exercises.tr: Gelecektim, ama son anda annem aradı.
exercises.en: I was going to come, but my mother called at the last minute.

exercises.prompt: Burası çok değişmiş; eskiden burada bir ilkokul vardı.
accept: This place has changed a lot; there used to be a primary school here.
This place has changed a lot; there used to be [an elementary|a] school here.
This place has changed a lot; there was [a primary|an elementary|a] school here before.
This place has really changed; there used to be [a primary|an elementary|a] school here.
It has changed a lot here; there used to be [a primary|an elementary|a] school here.

exercises.prompt: I was about to call you.

exercises.text: Bu yaz tatile ___ ama param yoktu.
exercises.en: I was going to go on holiday this summer, but I didn't have any money.

reject.why: *Gideceğim* is **I will go**. The plan is in the past and fell through: *gidecektim*.
*Gittim* says you went. With *ama param yoktu*, you didn't: *gidecektim*.

exercises.prompt: Nothing is as it used to be.
accept: Artık hiçbir şey eskisi gibi değil.
Hiçbir şey artık eskisi gibi değil.

exercises.en: Nothing is as it used to be.

exercises.question: Which sentence means **I could have helped you**?
exercises.explain: *et-* softens before a vowel: *ed-ebil-ir-di-m*, **I could have helped**.

exercises.prompt: We used to play in the street every day.
accept: Eskiden biz her gün sokakta oynardık.
